name: github/tests report parsing foundation (CHAOS-3336)
$limitation: This plan covers only the reviewable report-parser foundation. github/tests remains executor none and route_ready false; Actions/jobs/acceptance fetches, secure two-hop artifact download, Cobertura, six sinks/readbacks, tenant collision and crash recovery do not exist yet and are explicitly not claimed.

mutations.rationale: one run may parse at most 200 classified reports so an artifact set cannot create unbounded CPU and row volume
untrusted artifact XML containing a DTD must be rejected before decoding
failure stack text persisted from an untrusted report is capped at the Python contract's 4096 bytes
a JUnit failure element must normalize to failed and contribute to the suite's failed count
an incoherent coverage report must be rejected instead of skewing TestOps rollups
LCOV files without LF/LH must derive total and covered lines from unique DA records exactly like the live Python parser
coverage service attribution must choose the service represented by the most report files, not the first source path
